title: Operator Booking Amendments and Traveller Management
outcome: Approved operator staff can propose and confirm governed traveller and occupancy amendments for one operator-owned booking with an authoritative price-impact preview, optimistic concurrency and append-only audit history.
actor: Approved operator staff responsible for servicing confirmed bookings and traveller parties.
modules: Booking owns amendment lifecycle, booked traveller snapshot, occupancy, financial snapshot and amendment audit history.
Traveller owns reusable traveller identity; this slice changes only the booking traveller snapshot and does not mutate passport/document records.
Pricing remains authoritative for occupancy and traveller-count repricing; the browser never calculates commercial rules.
Payments remains append-only and is not mutated by booking amendment confirmation.
Web provides a governed preview-and-confirm workflow inside the existing operator shell.
routes: Amend booking -> edit traveller snapshot and occupancy
Confirmed amendment -> refreshed booking detail and amendment history
acceptance: An approved operator can start an amendment only for a booking owned by the active operator.
Amendment policy explicitly allows or rejects the current booking lifecycle state before any write occurs.
The proposed occupancy and traveller count must remain consistent with NoorPath occupancy rules.
Traveller basic booking-snapshot facts can be added, removed or corrected without changing Documents, Visa or reusable traveller identity records.
Preview returns authoritative current and proposed commercial snapshots plus the price delta; the browser does not calculate pricing rules.
A price-changing amendment requires an explicit preview token and confirmation against the unchanged booking version.
Stale booking/amendment versions fail safely with conflict feedback and do not partially mutate the booking.
Confirmed changes append an immutable amendment/audit record containing actor, reason, before/after snapshots and correlation metadata.
Payment attempts, refunds, visa decisions, document states and cancellation state are not mutated by this workflow.
Loading, validation, forbidden/not-found, stale-conflict and recoverable-error states are explicit.
Desktop and mobile navigation, keyboard operation, target size, reflow and serious/critical accessibility checks pass.
Product Owner approval is required for the exact certified SHA before merge; deployment remains separately approved.
policyDecisionsRequired: Use preview-then-confirm for every amendment; price-changing amendments can never be applied directly from edit state.
Treat booking traveller rows as the booked operational snapshot; reusable identity and passport/document data stay module-owned.
Use optimistic concurrency and append-only audit evidence for every confirmed amendment.
Do not silently reconcile money: any payment/refund consequence remains a separate Payments/Refund workflow.
exclusions: Payment capture, payment adjustment or refund execution.
Reusable traveller identity editing outside its owning module.
